headlines.title: 구윤철 " 외환시장 예의주시...과도한 쏠림엔 즉시 조치 "
headlines.summary: 미국 관세와 이란 전쟁 영향에 외환시장 변동성이 커진 가운데 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 지나친 쏠림에는 필요한 조치를 즉시 취할 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 구 부총리는 오늘 오전 정부서울청사에서 주재한 시장상황점검회의에서 대외 불확실성이 높은 상황에서 불안 심리가 확산하지 않도록 높은 경계감을 가지고 예의주시하고 있다며 이같이 언급했습니다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 과도한 쏠림 즉시 대응 "… 환율 변동성 확대 경계
headlines.summary: 중동 전쟁·외국인 순매도에 외환시장 변동성 확대 정부, 금융·외환시장 리스크 점검 강화 채권시장 변동성에도 관계기관 공조 대응 [서울=뉴시스] 고범준 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 2일 청와대에서 열린 제24회 국무회의 겸 제11차 비상경제점검회의에서 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 대화하고 있다. 2026.06.02. bjko@newsis.

headlines.title: 환율 13.6원 오른 1530원 개장 … 2009년 ‘글로벌 금융위기’ 이후 처음
headlines.summary: 5월 외환보유액 8.8억달러 감소 구윤철, 시장개입 가능성도 시사 환율 ‘고공행진’ 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 현황판 앞을 한 직원이 지나가고 있다. 이날 원·달러 환율은 전날 주간 거래 종가보다 13.6원 오른 1530.0원에 개장했는데, 환율이 1530원을 넘겨 거래를 시작한 것은 글로벌 금융위기였던 2009년 3월 10일(1554.

headlines.title: 원/달러 환율 , 3월 이후 첫 1530원 돌파…美 관세 · 중동 영향 겹쳤다
headlines.summary: (서울=뉴스1) 권현진 기자 = 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피와 원·달러 환욜이 표시되고 있다. 이날 환율은 미국과 이란의 군사적 충돌 재개에 강달러 기조가 강해지며 달러·원 환율이 1530원까지 치솟았다. 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 177.67포인트(2.02%) 내린 8,623.82로 출발했다. 2026.6.

headlines.title: 환율 두달 만에 다시 1530원대로
headlines.summary: 장중 1530.8원, 3월 31일 이후 최고치 외환보유액도 5월 8억8000만弗 감소 이란의 미군기지 공격에 유가 등 상승 구윤철 “과도 쏠림 즉시 조치 취할 것” 원/달러 환율이 약 두 달 만에 1530원을 다시 돌파했다. 시작가 기준으로는 글로벌 금융위기 이후 처음이다. 서울 중구 명동 일대 환전소 모습.

headlines.title: OECD 한국 성장 률 2.6% 전망, G20중 전망 상향폭 최대
headlines.summary: 세계경제 성장률 전망치, 3월(2.9%) 대비 하향된 2.8% 제시 한국경제 성장률은 같은 기간 1.7%→2.6%, G20국가 중 상향폭 최대 (부산=뉴스1) 윤일지 기자 = 지난 3월 우리나라 수출이 반도체 '슈퍼 사이클'(초호황)에 힘입어 사상 처음으로 800억 달러를 돌파하며 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 닭고기 수급난 … 굽네치킨, 가격 인상 대신 중량 줄였다
headlines.summary: 닭다리살 순살·윙봉·통다리 중량 축소 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’ 시행 6개월만 첫사례 “판매가·공급가 인상 어렵자 고육지책” [굽네치킨 홈페이지] 고병원성 AI(조류인플루엔자) 여파로 닭고기 수급난을 겪는 프랜차이즈 치킨업계에서 중량 조정 사례가 나왔다. 정부가 슈링크플레이션 방지를 위해 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’를 시행한 지 약 6개월 만이다.

headlines.title: 중소기업 10곳 중 7곳 “원부자재값 20%이상↑”
headlines.summary: 중기중앙회, 410개 중기 대상 조사 36.1% “현재 재고로 1개월도 못 버텨” 현상황 지속시 40% 조업 축소할 것 중동 정세 불안 이후 원부자재를 쓰는 중소기업 10곳 중 7곳이 주요 원부자재 매입단가가 20% 이상 올랐다고 응답했다. 보유 재고가 1개월 미만이라는 기업도 36.

headlines.title: 수도권 레미콘 총파업 … 반도체 건설현장도 올스톱
headlines.summary: 수도권 믹서트럭 8일부터 운행중단 예고 평택·용인 반도체 공사현장 차질 우려 노조성 인정·건설사 직접 협상 변수도 수도권 레미콘 운송사업자들이 8일부터 전면 운행 중단을 예고하며 각종 공사 현장의 차질도 현실화되고 있다. 사진은 대기 중인 레미콘 믹서트럭들의 모습.  [연합] 수도권 레미콘 운송사업자들이 오는 8일부터 전면 운행 중단에 들어간다.

headlines.title: 루비오 “미국 기업 향한 한국의 일부 태도, 무역합의에 영향 줬다”
headlines.summary: 하원 외교위원회 청문회 출석 “한국 정권 좌경화” 질문에 응답 USTR 새 관세 예고속 촉각 마코 루비오 미 국무장관이 3일 워싱턴DC 의사당에서 열린 상원 세출위원회에 출석해 발언하고 있다.

headlines.title: 일자리 진입 3년째 감소, 역대 최소 … 재작년 청년층 7만3천명 ↓

headlines.title: 배달 라이더도 최저임금 받나 …본격 논의 시작
headlines.summary: 사진=연합뉴스 내년도 최저임금 결정을 위한 논의가 본격 시작되는 가운데, 올해 최저임금위원회에서는 배달라이더와 택배기사 등 도급제 노동자에 대한 최저임금 적용 여부가 핵심 쟁점으로 떠오르고 있다. 3일 정부부처 등에 따르면 최저임금위원회는 오는 4일 오후 3시 정부세종청사에서 제3차 전원회의를 연다.

headlines.title: [ 공항 이 살아야 지방 이 산다]⑥ 지방공항은 다 적자? … 대구 · 청주 공항은 ...
headlines.summary: 대구·청주공항 흑자 전환 국제선 확대 영향 청주공항, 이용객 20%가 수도권 거주자 충북관광협의체 등 지자체와 협력도 적극적 지방공항은 적자라는 공식을 깨고 비상하는 공항이 있다. 청주공항과 대구공항이다. 두 공항은 한때 100억원이 넘는 영업적자를 기록하던 공항이었지만, 이제는 국제선 유치의 효과로 큰 폭의 수익성 개선을 이뤄냈다.

key_headlines.title: Korean Won Breaks 1,530 per Dollar for First Time Since 2009 Financial Crisis
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate surged to 1,530 won per dollar on June 4, the highest level since the 2009 global financial crisis, driven by strong dollar demand amid U.S. tariffs and Middle East tensions. Korea's foreign exchange reserves declined by 880 million dollars in May, with policymakers signaling possible market intervention.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Eyes 1 Trillion Dollar Export Target as Semiconductor and Power Equipment Boom
key_headlines.summary: Korea's exports reached 700 billion dollars for the first time last year and are targeting 900 billion dollars in 2026, with potential to surpass Japan and become the world's fifth-largest exporting nation. The AI boom is driving strong growth in semiconductor and power equipment exports.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Capital Region Ready-Mix Concrete Strike Threatens Semiconductor Construction Sites
key_headlines.summary: Ready-mix concrete transport companies in the Seoul metropolitan area announced a complete halt of operations starting June 8, threatening construction disruptions at major semiconductor fabrication plants in Pyeongtaek and Yongin. The strike poses risks to ongoing semiconductor facility expansion projects.

key_headlines.title: Consumer Inflation Exceeds 3 Percent for First Time in 26 Months Amid Oil Price Surge
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's consumer price inflation surged above 3 percent for the first time in 26 months, driven by rising oil prices from Middle East tensions and food price instability. Engine oil prices have increased significantly, with maintenance costs rising by 10,000 to 40,000 won compared to last year.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's Growth Forecast on Semiconductor Strength; Nominal Growth Expected to Exceed 10 Percent
key_headlines.summary: The OECD sharply raised Korea's growth forecast on the back of semiconductor sector strength, with nominal growth expected to surpass 10 percent for the first time in 24 years. The GDP deflator forecast was also raised to 7.6 percent, reflecting robust economic momentum.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy faces mixed signals as the won-dollar exchange rate hits 1,530 won, the highest level since the 2009 financial crisis, driven by strong dollar demand and Middle East instability. Consumer inflation has exceeded 3 percent for the first time in 26 months due to surging oil prices, threatening household purchasing power as prices for essential items like engine oil and food surge. Meanwhile, Korea's export sector shows remarkable strength, with exports reaching 700 billion dollars last year and targeting 900 billion dollars in 2026, potentially surpassing Japan to become the world's fifth-largest exporting nation. The semiconductor and power equipment sectors are driving this export boom amid the AI boom. However, a ready-mix concrete strike threatens to disrupt semiconductor construction projects in the Seoul metropolitan area starting June 8.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The OECD significantly raised Korea's growth forecast, projecting nominal growth will exceed 10 percent for the first time in 24 years, driven by semiconductor sector strength and the AI boom. The U.S. Federal Reserve's Beige Book indicates persistent inflation pressures from Middle East energy shocks and employment stagnation, with the Fed expected to hold rates steady at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting. Inflation concerns are mounting globally, with the OECD warning that prolonged Gulf energy crises could push global growth rates into single digits. Korea's consumer inflation surpassed 3 percent for the first time in 26 months, driven primarily by oil price spikes from Middle East tensions, adding pressure on monetary policy considerations.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market declined, with the KOSPI falling 2.02 percent to 8,623.82 amid foreign investor selling and currency volatility, while the KOSDAQ fell 2.30 percent to 1,050.03. The won-dollar exchange rate surged 13.6 won to 1,530 won on opening, marking the first time in 17 years the won weakened past this level, reflecting capital outflows and increased risk aversion. The U.S. stock market declined across all major indices amid Middle East tensions and rising oil prices, with market expectations shifting toward potential interest rate hikes by December 2026. Bitcoin prices fell to their lowest levels since the Iran conflict outbreak at 64,092 dollars, pressured by strategic selling, Middle East instability, and capital reallocation from cryptocurrency to equities.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK Chairman Chey Tae-won is actively strengthening Korea's semiconductor alliances, recently meeting with Foxconn Chairman Liu Young-way to discuss cooperation in robotics, energy management, and battery technology sectors. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is visiting Korea to explore physical AI opportunities with Korean robotics startups, positioning Korea as an optimal market for AI robot deployment across manufacturing, shipbuilding, logistics, and steel industries. Samsung Electronics maintains its leading position in NAND flash memory with 29 percent market share in Q1 2026, as the global NAND market reached a record 46 billion dollars, up 3.5 times year-over-year, driven by AI data center demand. Anthropic's technology leaders are visiting Naver on June 16 to engage with Korean developers, marking the company's push to expand cooperation in Korea's advanced AI infrastructure market.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices continued to rise for the second consecutive week, increasing 0.25 percent, while full-year jeonse (long-term lease) price increases have reached six times last year's levels, signaling severe housing market imbalances. Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon identified housing as Seoul's most critical issue, warning of a real estate crisis if policies fail to address declining jeonse availability and surging monthly rent prices. Apartments under the price ceiling system are experiencing 2.5 times higher subscription competition than general units this year due to their relatively affordable pricing in the expensive metropolitan area. Policymakers are exploring alternative housing solutions beyond apartments, including officetel and multi-unit residential buildings, to address the supply shortage in Seoul and surrounding areas through 2030.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve's Beige Book indicates energy-driven inflation pressures and employment stagnation, with the Fed expected to maintain steady rates at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, though market expectations for December rate hikes have risen to 41.1 percent. Growing hawkish sentiment within the Federal Reserve, including even Trump-friendly appointees, is raising the possibility of interest rate increases as inflation concerns mount and long-term inflation expectations risk becoming embedded. The won-dollar exchange rate reached 1,530 won for the first time since the 2009 financial crisis, reflecting broader dollar strength amid inflation concerns and Middle East tensions affecting global markets. U.S. stock markets declined amid Middle East geopolitical tensions and surging oil prices, while the administration signals potential tariff investigations and CPI releases will continue to pressure the currency markets.
sections.AI & Economy: Ryu ton AX announced an AI agent executive platform to help enterprises automate business operations by overcoming data infrastructure challenges that currently hinder AI implementation in corporations. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon maintains optimism about AI and the U.S. economy long-term, predicting that within ten years the economy will achieve low unemployment and high productivity, though warning that market sentiment can shift rapidly from greed to fear. Anthropic, developer of Claude AI, is expanding its Korean market presence through developer meetups at Naver, leveraging Korea's advanced AI infrastructure, semiconductor capabilities, and manufacturing expertise to compete against OpenAI. Focus AI completed 8 billion won in equity financing to accelerate its AI physical security and industrial safety solutions business expansion.
sections.Others: TiRobotics secured a 9.88 million dollar contract to supply autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) to a Ford Energy battery manufacturing facility in Kentucky, expanding its North American smart logistics automation market presence. Korean retail investors are shifting from U.S. leveraged semiconductor ETFs (SOXL) to domestic semiconductor leverage products, redirecting capital toward leveraging domestic semiconductor exposure without tax and time-lag burdens. Bitcoin prices fell to 64,092 dollars, the lowest level since the Iran conflict outbreak, pressured by strategic institutional selling, Middle East geopolitical instability, and capital reallocation trends. The U.S. International Trade Court received warnings from judges regarding appeals on tariff refund decisions, as trade disputes continue to complicate global commerce dynamics.
